main.description: Pro Top International is an import & export sourcing company connecting brands worldwide with manufacturers in China, specialising in personal care electrical appliances.
main.tagline: Global sourcing & supply chain solutions from Hong Kong

profile.title: Company Profile
profile.text1: Pro Top is an import & export company that connects clients with manufacturers in China, acting as their sourcing partner and liaison from first request to final delivery. We serve customers across the United States, Asia and Australia, with strong experience in customs clearance, government commodity inspections and a notable trading history.
profile.text2: With offices in both Hong Kong and Dongguan, our team works directly alongside Chinese factories and manages efficient, cost-effective international export to our clients' markets. Supplied goods include, but are not limited to, Health & Personal Care and Electrical & Electronics.

highlights.title: Hong Kong & Dongguan
highlights.text: Two fully staffed offices, working side by side with our partner factories.

highlights.title: Customs & Inspection
highlights.text: Experienced in customs clearance and government commodity inspections.

highlights.title: Efficient Logistics
highlights.text: Cost-effective international export from China and Hong Kong to markets worldwide.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: We aim to be the connection that bridges imagination with reality — realising the creativity of our customers and bringing it to life, by supplying products of the highest quality and maintaining excellent service.

cta.text: Looking for a reliable sourcing partner in China?

products.title: Products
products.intro: Over years of operation, we have sourced and manufactured a wide range of personal care products for international brand owners, specialising in electrical hair appliances.
